answers.1:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata: {name: bo}
spec:
  backoffLimit: 1
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      containers:
      - name: c
        image: busybox:1.36
        command: ["sh", "-c", "exit 1"]
EOF
kubectl wait --for=condition=Failed job/bo -n $NS --timeout=120s

# 첫 시도 + 재시도 1번이 모두 실패하면 BackoffLimitExceeded
answers.2:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata: {name: dl}
spec:
  activeDeadlineSeconds: 20
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 0
      containers:
      - name: c
        image: busybox:1.36
        command: ["sleep", "3600"]
EOF
kubectl wait --for=condition=Failed job/dl -n $NS --timeout=90s
kubectl get job dl -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.status.conditions[0].reason}'

# 20초가 지나면 DeadlineExceeded
answers.3:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata: {name: ttl}
spec:
  ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 600
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      containers:
      - name: c
        image: busybox:1.36
        command: ["echo", "hi"]
EOF
kubectl get job ttl -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.spec.ttlSecondsAfterFinished}'

# 끝난 지 600초 뒤 Job 과 Pod 가 자동으로 지워진다
answers.4:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata: {name: idx}
spec:
  completionMode: Indexed
  completions: 3
  parallelism: 3
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      containers:
      - name: c
        image: busybox:1.36
        command: ["sh", "-c", "echo idx=$JOB_COMPLETION_INDEX"]
EOF
kubectl wait --for=condition=Complete job/idx -n $NS --timeout=120s
kubectl logs -l job-name=idx -n $NS

# 로그에 idx=0, idx=1, idx=2 가 나온다
answers.5:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: {name: rp}
spec:
  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 0
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ["sh", "-c", "sleep 5; touch /tmp/ready; sleep 3600"]
    readinessProbe:
      exec: {command: ["cat", "/tmp/ready"]}
      periodSeconds: 2
EOF
kubectl get pod rp -n $NS
kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready pod/rp -n $NS --timeout=90s

# 처음 몇 초는 READY 0/1, 파일이 생기면 1/1
answers.6:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: {name: lp}
spec:
  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 0
  containers:
  - name: web
    image: nginx:1.25
    livenessProbe:
      tcpSocket: {port: 80}
      periodSeconds: 5
EOF
kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready pod/lp -n $NS --timeout=90s

# 연결이 실패하면 컨테이너가 재시작된다. readiness 와 달리 트래픽 제외가 아니라 재시작이다
answers.7:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: {name: hk}
spec:
  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 0
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ["sleep", "3600"]
    lifecycle:
      postStart:
        exec:
          command: ["sh", "-c", "echo hook-ran > /tmp/started"]
EOF
kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready pod/hk -n $NS --timeout=90s
kubectl exec hk -n $NS -- cat /tmp/started

# postStart 가 끝나야 컨테이너가 Running 으로 표시된다
answers.8:
kubectl run latestpod -n $NS --image=busybox:latest --restart=Never -- sleep 3600
kubectl run fixedpod -n $NS --image=busybox:1.36 --restart=Never -- sleep 3600
kubectl get pod latestpod -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.spec.containers[0].imagePullPolicy}{"\n"}' > /tmp/q8.txt
kubectl get pod fixedpod -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.spec.containers[0].imagePullPolicy}{"\n"}' >> /tmp/q8.txt
cat /tmp/q8.txt

# latest → Always, 1.36 → IfNotPresent
answers.9:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: {name: tm}
spec:
  restartPolicy: Never
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ["sh", "-c", "echo oops > /dev/termination-log; exit 1"]
EOF
kubectl wait --for=jsonpath='{.status.phase}'=Failed pod/tm -n $NS --timeout=90s
kubectl get pod tm -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.status.containerStatuses[0].state.terminated.message}' > /tmp/q9.txt
cat /tmp/q9.txt

# 재시작되는 Pod 는 lastState.terminated.message 에서 읽는다
